title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（人与自我·做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（人与自我·做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：life　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 life 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 the elder ① lived the life that no youth in the village would have recorded, and he said the living was the whole of the year. The ② life, meaning the story itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a life, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ life in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ life at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A life, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the elder said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the life was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the story. The ⑥ life, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; life, he said, is either something you live or the only word that means both a story and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1952 the ⑦ life had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ life of the whole thing, the elder wrote in December, was one village and three years of recording; life, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ life I remember is the story recorded in the memoir, which closed in 1954 and is still recorded as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ life, my mother said in 1956, is the only story that improves by being recorded; every life, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a story. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 生命；人生（指村子里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 生命；人生（指那段人生本身，与拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：live the life 过这一段人生
D. n. 生命；人生（指留给孩子们守着的那个盼头那一段）
E. n. 人生之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的人生之事）
F. n. 生命；人生（指回忆录里写到、被记载的的那一段）
G. n. 意义、滋味（指一件事里人人都过却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 滋味（抽象总称，指人人都过却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: lived the life that no youth in the village would have recorded
The life, meaning the story itself and not the staff
the life at the far gate
the life was the whole of the matter
the life had become a line in a memoir
The life of the whole thing
A life, my mother said in 1956

answers.why: live the life 意为“过这一段人生”，1947 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记载的一段人生做了一遍。
life 意为“生命；人生”，指那段人生本身而不是拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
life 意为“生命；人生”，指村子里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
life 意为“生命；人生”，指最远那道村口留给孩子们守着的那个盼头那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
life 意为“意义、滋味”，指一件事里人人都过却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个意义就是那件事的全部。
life 意为“滋味”，指人人都过却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段人生，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
life 意为“生命；人生”，指回忆录里写到、被记载的的那一段，到 1952 年这一段成了回忆录里的一行。
life 意为“人生之事”，长者十二月写道，整件事的人生之事是一处村子和三个年头的记载。
life 意为“生命；人生”，我记得的是回忆录里记载过的那一段，1954 年过完了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一段。
life 为抽象总称，母亲 1956 年说，人生是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的人生。
